cases.derivation: Market value 40 x 230 = 9,200; plus declared unspent dividends 180 -> base 9,380. Hawl 369 days. Nisab 85 x 80 = 6,800 < 9,380. Zakat = 9,380 x 2.5% = 234.50. The benchmark aggregates this with the SPUS case to reproduce the published 11,755 -> 293.88.

case.price_source: AskZakariya published worked example (25 shares SPUS @ $95)

cases.derivation: Market value 25 x 95 = 2,375. Judged ALONE against the nisab 6,800 it is below -> zakat 0, status below-nisab. That is the correct per-holding behaviour: the published example aggregates both holdings (nisab is a wealth-level test), which is what the benchmark's aggregation row does.
